strategy: Taxonomy-first research: reduce duplication in dish records by identifying an authoritative Bihar-wide culinary reference set, then attach geographic context and Patna relevance without implying local availability. Secondary pass checked current event and product-discovery signals.

claims: Bihar government published a showcase list of 18 delicacies
list spans savory dishes, snacks, sweets and Bihari thali
several items have explicit geographic associations such as Maner laddoo, khaja, tilkut and khoye-ki-lai

document places Patna inside multiple Bihar tourism circuits

new_sources.title: HOGR — social food discovery product
claims: product combines social recommendations, food discovery, creator/influencer signals, video content and rewards

dedupe_actions: Created one canonical Bihar cuisine taxonomy rather than adding 18 disconnected dish records.
Kept geographic origin/context as attributes of the canonical dish, while reserving Patna availability for separately evidenced place records.
Kept Saras Mela as the existing event entity and added the newer reported attendance/sales observation as temporal evidence rather than a duplicate event.
Kept HOGR as product research rather than treating its features as evidence about Patna food.
contradictions_or_limits: The Indian Express source reports an official Bihar government list but is still secondary reporting; the NITI Aayog anthology independently corroborates several Bihar cuisine items but is not the same list.
A Bihar-wide canonical dish does not establish that a Patna venue serves the dish. Local availability requires place-level evidence.
Saras Mela attendance and sales figures are reported figures and should remain attributed, not treated as audited counts.
product_learnings: Crave Hunt needs a canonical dish layer before place discovery can scale without alias duplication.
Dish pages should distinguish culinary identity, geographic origin/context, and current Patna availability as three separate evidence states.
A strong discovery product can borrow HOGR's social/video discovery pattern while differentiating through provenance, locality intelligence and historical context rather than generic ratings.
